candidates.summary: the cors_allowed_origins comment an operator reads calls [] the default and names only cross-domain HTTP requests, while the default is ["*"] and the list now also decides which Origin /websocket upgrades
candidates.failure_scenario: an operator reading config.toml takes the shipped default for [] (CORS off) and does not learn that the default ["*"] lets every website open /websocket, nor that [] keeps the websocket same-origin while a narrowed list refuses an Origin naming the node's own host
candidates.verify_by: sed -n '28p;108p;170,172p' tm2/pkg/bft/rpc/config/config.go: line 28 says "Default value '[]' disables cors support", line 108 sets CORSAllowedOrigins: []string{"*"}
candidates.evidence: config.go:28 comment:"A list of origins a cross-domain request can be executed from\n Default value '[]' disables cors support\n Use '[\"*\"]' to allow any origin"; config.go:108 CORSAllowedOrigins: []string{"*"}; the line sits outside the round 4 diff
